name: EAGLS 70 mm APKWS launcher
description: Four-round 70 mm APKWS II launcher on a CROWS II mount with organic RPS-40 radar and EO/IR laser designator. Fielded to CENTCOM base defence 2026.

minRangeM.condition: minimum engagement range — no public figure; representative value covering rocket boost, fin deployment and guidance-section settling before the semi-active laser seeker can command

maxRangeM.condition: ranges up to about 10 km (10000 m)
maxRangeM.note: Inventory records 5000 m (5 km); the seed value is kept

maxAltitudeFt.condition: engagement altitude ceiling — UNKNOWN. Reporting says EAGLS engages Group 1 and Group 2 UAS 'at low altitude and moderate speeds' but gives no ceiling. Left null rather than substituting the Group 2 definitional altitude band, which describes the target class and not the weapon.
maxAltitudeFt.source: U.S. Deploys EAGLS Counter-Drone Air Defense System to Protect Middle East Bases

engageTimeS.condition: assignment-to-effect time — DERIVED, not published. Arithmetic: the Hydra 70 motor gives a burnout velocity near 700 m/s with an average velocity over a 5 km flight of roughly 500 m/s; 5,000 m / 500 m/s = 10 s time of flight. Add about 5 s for RWS slew, EO/IR handoff and laser designation settling: 10 + 5 = 15 s.
engageTimeS.source: Laser Rocket Anti-Drone Systems Being Rushed To U.S. Forces In The Middle East

pk.condition: single-shot probability of kill — UNKNOWN in the public record. 0.7 is a representative planning value only, NOT tested performance. It is held below the interceptor-missile entries because semi-active laser guidance needs an unbroken designation line and is documented as degraded by weather, dust and obscurants.
pk.source: U.S. Deploys EAGLS Counter-Drone Air Defense System to Protect Middle East Bases

seekerAcquisitionRangeM.note: Planning factor: the distributed-aperture semi-active laser seeker homes on the spot the CROWS II designator places on the target, so acquisition is bounded by the designation range, taken as the placarded 10 km engagement range in this file. BAE publishes no seeker acquisition range.

lethalRadiusM.condition: M151 high-explosive warhead, burst radius about 10 m; the greater than 50 m figure quoted in the same sources is the personnel casualty radius, not an airframe lethal radius
lethalRadiusM.source: Hydra 70 open references (Wikipedia and aircav.com), quoted from the search index; the pages were not opened

guidanceNoiseM.condition: accuracy better than 1 m CEP; the vendor bound is taken as the 1 sigma miss contribution

maxFlyoutSpeedMps.condition: maximum speed 1000 m/s (3280 fps); flyoutSpeedMps keeps the 739 m/s average

boostTimeS.condition: MK 66 MOD 4 motor, 6.7 kN for 1.1 s; peak speed is reached at burnout
